outcome: maternal postpartum infection (any infection within 30 days postpartum)
surgical site infection after cesarean section
cohort: A nationwide cohort of 546,864 deliveries with live-born singletons in Denmark between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2017.
finding: Induction of labor was associated with a significantly increased risk of maternal postpartum infection (aOR, 1.24; 95% CI, 1.21-1.27) compared to spontaneous onset of labor.
